# Vendored dependencies

## uPlot 1.6.32

Charting library, MIT licensed. See `LICENSE-uPlot`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot
- Files: `uPlot.iife.min.js`, `uPlot.min.css`

Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the site has no third-party runtime
dependencies and works offline once loaded.

To upgrade, copy `dist/uPlot.iife.min.js` and `dist/uPlot.min.css` from the
desired release and update the version number above.
